title: Unity CLI Context Descriptor
description: Describes a read-only context exposed by the Unity CLI. Context provides observation without mutation — if a capability modifies Unity state, it must be a Tool, not a Context. Baseline schema for this descriptor type.

name.description: Dotted context identifier, e.g. 'project.info'. Must be unique across all contexts.

description.description: One-paragraph explanation of what the context provides.

source.description: Origin: built-in (shipped with CLI), project (custom context in Unity project), extension (from an extension package).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the context's input parameters.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the context's output.

resourceUri.description: URI template for resource identification, e.g. 'unity-cli://project/info'.

available.description: Whether the context is currently available based on session state.

requiresPackages.description: Unity package names required by this context at runtime.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint material for detecting descriptor/handler drift. Project contexts only.

equivalentUnityMcp.description: Mapping to equivalent unity-mcp resource URI, for parity tracking.

cliCommand.description: CLI command to read this context, e.g. 'context read project.info'.
